verdicts.reason: A has no collisions and a clear vertical flow ending in the CTA, but 'WEEKEND ONLY' has moved from an eyebrow above the headline to below the body copy, which breaks the original reading order. The body also wraps to leave 'sparkling.' as an orphan, the text is left-aligned while the bottle and button are centred, and the gap between the bottle and the CTA is tight. B has a severe collision: the body copy 'Every mixed case of Solstice sparkling' runs straight through the bottle and its label, so both are unreadable. The bottle is also shrunk and floats oddly, and the bottom quarter of the canvas is dead space under an oversized CTA.
